summary.headline: Astrological Signs of Death
summary.text: Astrological judgments on the manner and circumstances of death: malefics, the Sun, Moon, Mars, Saturn, Mercury, and the lunar Dragon’s head and tail signify death by fire, iron, torture, prison, hanging, ambush, poison, or purging medicines, while afflicted significators and elemental signs indicate famous, hidden, subterranean, or violent deaths.
